msg: I will assign the colours you will pick to 2 groups which will take you to 2 different forests with different colour baskets. Group one will have all the light colours and purple. Group two will have all the dark colours and pink.Start the game by picking colours from group one consistently. If you see the number of mushrooms drop to 4 or lower swap to picking colours from group two. If you see the number of mushrooms from group two drop to 4 or lower swap back to group one.You will sometimes have low amounts of mushrooms no matter group you swap to.I would repeat the words light and purple in my head to help me remember when I should pick group one colours. I repeated dark and pink in my head for group two colours.Good luck.
